goal: Elevar o CVG Diagnostics Hub de MVP local 78/100 para um artefato State of Art / AAA: fechar gaps locais, ampliar provas de persistência, segurança, jornadas, operação, UX e rastreabilidade; preservar gates clínicos e hospitalares como dependências externas explícitas.

attempts.outcome: Alias and readiness fixtures implemented; PostgreSQL integration remains fail-closed because the host has no opt-in/live database.
attempts.hypothesis: The PostgreSQL harness can be collected and the readiness contract can be represented without weakening the production guard.
attempts.evidence_delta: Collection advanced to 10 integration tests plus 6 harness tests; default unit regression is 299/299.

attempts.outcome: A disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster executed the expanded harness and sample-lineage integration without weakening the opt-in guard.
attempts.hypothesis: The real 001–009 migration set and relational sample-lineage seam can be exercised on an isolated loopback database while unsafe defaults remain fail-closed.
attempts.evidence_delta: The current PostgreSQL packet records 3 files and 20/20 tests, including 14 lineage/integration tests, 6 durable-store harness tests, migration-009 constraints, complete item membership, exact replay/idempotency, atomic rollback, readiness, projection/read/reconciliation and negative SQL checks.

open_findings.summary: Disposable PostgreSQL execution now passes locally; target CI/production repetition, browser-backed persistence, representative workload, recovery and cutover remain open.

attempts.outcome: fast-uri upgraded through the lockfile and the high-severity audit gate is clean.
attempts.hypothesis: The reported HIGH vulnerability can be remediated by refreshing the resolved transitive package without changing application behavior.
attempts.evidence_delta: Resolved fast-uri is 3.1.7 and npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities; typecheck, lint, tests and build remain green.

attempts.outcome: Browser authentication was stabilized with hydration-aware API synchronization and isolated synthetic rate-limit addresses.
attempts.hypothesis: The browser flake is caused by a cold hydrated form/native-submit race plus shared test rate-limit state.
attempts.evidence_delta: Independent E2E verification passes 45/45 with fail-on-flaky-tests and no retry; accessibility passes 6/6; data remains memory-backed.

open_findings.summary: Browser evidence is synthetic memory only; PostgreSQL-backed browser execution and manual clinical/accessibility acceptance remain open.

attempts.outcome: Normative docs, traceability, current evidence, migration-map facts and agent state were reconciled against the post-wave checks.
attempts.hypothesis: A single current evidence vocabulary can distinguish local PASS from external or environmental blockers without overstating readiness.
attempts.evidence_delta: Docs validator and diff check pass; current 299/49, coverage, 45/45 no-retry E2E and explicit blockers are recorded.

open_findings.summary: Clinical governance, institutional identity, production approval and independent requirement-to-digest closure remain external or critic-owned gates.

attempts.outcome: Added an additive transactional relational clinical core and readiness contract without changing the authoritative snapshot or seeding policy thresholds.
attempts.hypothesis: An expand-only relational core can be introduced compatibly with the current text-ID JSONB runtime and verified statically before a live database is available.
attempts.evidence_delta: 27/27 migration contract assertions pass and the full unit suite is 299/299; live migration, EXPLAIN, backfill and cutover remain unverified.

open_findings.summary: Disposable PostgreSQL execution now passes for migration 009, complete sample membership, exact replay and atomic rollback; target-environment EXPLAIN evidence, populated backfill rehearsal, dual-read and cutover proof remain open.

attempts.outcome: CI workflow hardened with fail-on-flaky browser gates and always-uploaded diagnostic artifacts while preserving PostgreSQL opt-in fail-closed behavior.
attempts.hypothesis: CI can make retry-recovered browser failures visible and preserve enough artifacts for independent diagnosis without weakening safety gates.
attempts.evidence_delta: Available YAML parsers accept the workflow; flags and artifact conditions were checked statically; no remote execution is available.

open_findings.summary: The workflow has not executed in a remote CI environment from this host.

attempts.outcome: Independent Final Critic rejected AAA-READY while preserving the mutation sentinel; rework is required across relational persistence, distributed operations and external release gates.
attempts.hypothesis: The current implementation and evidence satisfy the frozen AAA-1 bar for local and external release readiness.
attempts.evidence_delta: Fresh critic classified 5 criteria PASS, 5 FAIL, 6 BLOCKED and 6 NOT VERIFIED; post-fingerprint matched pre-fingerprint exactly.

open_findings.summary: AAA-08/09 and downstream persistence, delivery, realtime, observability, recovery and release gates are not closed.
